description.text: Sports science is an interdisciplinary subject that studies the laws of human movement, the improvement of athletic ability, and the relationship between exercise and health. It integrates fields such as biology, medicine, physics, and psychology, and is dedicated to addressing issues such as "how to optimize athletic performance", "How does exercise affect health", and "how to prevent and recover from sports injuries". Its core goals include: revealing the mechanism of action of exercise on the human body system, formulating scientific training plans, promoting public health management, and advancing the development of sports rehabilitation technology.

duration.text: The Sports Science at South China Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4722 USD/per year ￥ 34000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) Equal to a master's degree (or above) in China;(2) Full transcripts of final education, original or notarized version, in notarized Chinese or English Translation.(3) A scanned copy of score reports of the HSK tests. Admitted students are required to submit original copies of those official documents for verification. Those who provide fake materials will be disqualified from admission.)(4) Personal statement in Chinese or English including study and working experience (if available), academic research experience and results, research proposal and so on (including applicants’ understanding of the discipline or major they are applying for and their plan, about 1000 words).(5) Two recommendation letters in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors in the graduated university or college.(6) A scanned copy of passport valid for more than 6 months.(7) A scanned copy of passport including the photo page, and all pages with visa records, and entry and exit stamps (if any).(8) Single person color photo without a hat, taken recently within the last 6 months, same size as the one on the passport.(9) Other requirements★ Applicants are required to submit additional materials if necessary.★Documents that can prove applicants’ comprehensive abilities, such as certificates of awards, certificates, admission letters from foreign universities and so on, can be submitted together with their application.★ Application materials will NOT be returned regardless of the application result.

requirements.text: 2.1 General requirements(1) Applicants must abide by the laws and regulations of China and the rules and regulations of the university, and respect Chinese social customs.(2) Applicants should be healthy, both physically and psychologically, with no criminal record, and meet the physical standards required for applying for a student visa or residence permit.2.2 Age and identification requirements(1) Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports.(2) Applicants should be aged between 18 and 45 years (Scholarship applicants must meet the age requirements of each program).2.3 Academic requirements(1) Equal to a master's degree (or above) in China;(2) Full transcripts of final Chemistry, original or notarized version, in notarized Chinese or English Translation.2.4 Language proficiency(1) Applicants should hold an HSK (Level 5) certificate after February 2023.(2) A scanned copy of score reports of the HSK tests. Admitted students are required to submit original copies of those official documents for verification. Those who provide fake materials will be disqualified from admission.2.5 Financial conditionApplicants should be able to pay tuition fees, accommodation and related daily living expenses.
